prompt: Open Books to Scrape. Extract the first 8 books on the homepage into a table with columns: title, price, rating.
On Books to Scrape, collect books from page 1 and page 2 (use Next). Produce a table with columns: title, price, rating, page (1 or 2). Need at least 20 rows total. Sort is not required.

success_criteria.notes: Must paginate; page column must include both 1 and 2.

prompt: On Books to Scrape, collect the first 5 books (title and price) into a table. Save this workflow as a Skill named books-first5 if supported; otherwise write a reusable step list titled books-first5 with numbered steps that another agent can follow verbatim.

success_criteria.notes: Pass if Skill books-first5 exists OR a numbered reusable procedure with that name is returned, AND a 5-row table is produced.

prompt: Reuse the Skill books-first5 (or the reusable steps from self:skill-reuse-001a) on Books to Scrape to collect the first 5 books again (title and price). Do not re-derive the workflow from scratch if the Skill/steps are available; mention that you reused them.

success_criteria.notes: Pass if answer cites reuse of books-first5 AND returns 5-row table. Fail if workflow reinvented with no reuse claim when Skill exists.

prompt: Multi-source compare: (1) Open https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Python_(programming_language) and extract: official website (from infobox if present), first release year, and the first sentence of the lead. (2) Open https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JavaScript and extract the same three fields. (3) Return one markdown table with columns: language, official_website, first_release_year, lead_first_sentence. Do not invent fields; use "not listed" if missing.

success_criteria.notes: Two distinct Wikipedia sources; compare/structure output required.
